تبتدرين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِرِينَ (tabtadirīna) /tab.ta.di.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# تُبْتَدَرِينَ (tubtadarīna) /tub.ta.da.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
